concept: Kinesis Data Streams: high throughput, multiple consumers, replay
tests: Choosing a service for streaming ingestion of millions of events per second with multiple independent consumers and re-reads.
expected: Kinesis Data Streams — a real-time stream; multiple consumers read the same data independently, retention up to 365 days (replay). Triggers: "millions of events per second", "multiple independent consumers", "replay", "retained 7 days", "clickstream".
why_not: SQS deletes messages after processing, no replay for multiple consumers; SNS — fan-out without retention; Amazon MQ — a classic broker, not massive streaming.
